mapper.sql: reward_id, reward_name, reward_amount, reward_price, applied_count, reward_delivery_date, reward_description, project_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reward (reward_name, reward_amount, reward_price, applied_count, reward_delivery_date, reward_description, project_id) VALUES (#{rewardName}, #{rewardAmount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{rewardPrice}, 0, #{rewardDeliveryDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{rewardDescription, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{projectId})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reward WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND reward_amount IS NOT NULL
SELECT FROM reward WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY reward_id
